sentences.text: Soumitra Maity vs Unknown on 27 March, 2026
Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh 27.03.2026

[G.S.D]
 CRM (M) 391 of 2026  In re : An Application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of  Criminal Procedure, 1973/under Section 483 of the BNSS, 2023 in  connection with Nandigram PS Case No. 0210 dated 28.03.2024 u/s  376(3)/506 of the IPC, 1860 read with Sections 6 of the POCSO Act,
 2012 (corresponding to POCSO Case No. 17/2024).
 -And-

In the matter of : Soumitra Maity  ... Petitioner(s  Mr. Sandipan Ganguly, Sr Adv  Mr. Sumanta Ganguly  Mr. Sandip Chakraborty  ... for the Petitioner(s)
 Mr. Anupam Dasadhikari  Mr. D. Brahmin  ... for the State-respondent(s)
Affidavit of Service filed be kept with the record.

Learned Senior advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody for about two years and till date trial has not been concluded, as such, he prays that the petitioner may be released on bail.

Learned advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits that the trial is at the advanced stage and, in all probability, the evidence of the investigating officer will commence from the next date fixed.
Having considered the same, at this stage, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
Hence, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is Rejected.
The learned trial court would ensure that the verdict of this case is pronounced by 30th June, 2026.
The petitioner would be at liberty to pray for bail after the aforesaid period is over.
